behavior: Retain at most one unfinished visible trailing CR. Strip supported complete ANSI first so ANSI-only reads do not prematurely finish a CR before LF. Existing stateless stripper still normalizes complete output. NonLF resumes the standalone-CR newline policy; reader closure flushes CR once.
contract: Original prose/signatures/symbols/tr unchanged; strip_terminal_codes/find_urls fullAST unchanged. No helper/module/timer/debounce/caption.
